terms.content: Welcome to the website https://radio.eplus.dev ("Radio ePlus") a product by ePlus.DEV. Please carefully read the Agreement on provision and use of services on the Website https://radio.eplus.dev before you use the features on the "Radio." Website ePlus. Once registered, you have read, understood, accepted and complied with the terms below:

article_1.title: Article 1: Nonprofit
article_1.line_1: We are committed to free forever, with no fees of any kind.
article_1.line_2: We recognize the use of free content from all over the station, content developers from all over the world, so I wanted to spread this content to everyone.

article_2.title: Article 2: Digital Millennium Copyright Act
article_2.line_1: Radio ePlus takes matters of Intellectual Property very seriously and is committed to meeting the needs of content owners while helping them manage publication of their content online. It should be noted that Radio ePlus is a radio station portal linking to third party websites by pop ups.
article_2.line_2: Any content on these third party websites are the responsibility of those sites and not Radio ePlus. We have no knowledge of whether content on third party websites is or is not authorized by the content owner as that is a matter between the site that hosts the audio content and the content owner. Radio ePlus does not host any audio content on its servers or network.

player.title: Radio player
player.choose_station: Choose a station to start listening
player.ios_volume_hint: On iPhone or iPad, use your device's volume buttons or Control Center to adjust the sound.

about.title: About Radio ePlus
about.description: Find and listen to live radio stations from different countries, all in one place.

discover.title: Discover radio
discover.body: Radio ePlus organizes internet radio stations by region and country so listeners can find local and international stations from one consistent interface.

playback.title: Direct playback
playback.body: Choose a station and press Play. If a station has another listening link, we can try it when the first one does not work.

availability.title: Station information can change
availability.body: Radio stations manage their own broadcasts and schedules. A station may be offline, change its schedule, or show song information later than expected.

service.title: Radio made easy
service.body: Find a station you like, save it as a favorite, and keep listening as you browse on your phone or computer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Learn what information the website saves and what happens when you search for or listen to a station.

accounts.title: Accounts and payments
accounts.body: Radio ePlus does not require a user account and does not provide a payment or checkout flow on this website. Please do not submit sensitive personal information through public project channels.

preferences.title: Your saved preferences
preferences.body: Your browser may save your language, color theme, favorite stations, and recently played stations on this device. This helps you pick up where you left off.

search.title: Search services
search.body: When you search for a station, a search service such as Algolia may receive your search words. That provider has its own privacy policy.

streams.title: When you listen to a station
streams.body: Playing radio connects your device to the station or the service that delivers its audio. Those services may see your IP address and basic browser information.

logs.title: Keeping the website working
logs.body: Our website and security providers may keep details such as your IP address, browser, pages visited, and access times to run the site, protect it, and fix problems.

sharing.title: Sale and sharing of data
sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We use Google Analytics 4 to count visits and page views on the main website. Search and radio providers may also receive information when you use their services.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: This policy may be updated when the website, providers or data practices change. The current version and update date are published on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The conditions for using Radio ePlus and its links to third-party radio services.

service.title: Use of the service
service.body: Radio ePlus is provided as a free radio discovery and playback interface. You may use the website for lawful personal access to publicly reachable radio services.

third_party.title: Radio stations and other providers
third_party.body: Radio stations provide their own broadcasts. They decide what to play, when to broadcast, and whether listening is available in your country. Some stations may show ads or stop working without notice.

copyright.title: Copyright and trademarks
copyright.body: Station names, logos, audio, and other materials belong to their owners. If you own the rights and want something corrected or removed, send us the page link and information to support your request.

acceptable_use.title: Using Radio ePlus responsibly
acceptable_use.body: Please use the website lawfully. Do not disrupt the website or radio providers, access restricted services without permission, collect large amounts of data in a harmful way, or share harmful software.

availability.title: When a station is unavailable
availability.body: We provide the website and station list as they are. We cannot promise that every station, schedule, song title, or listening link will always be correct or available.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: These terms may be updated as the project or supported services evolve. Continued use after an update means you are using the service under the current published terms.

contact.title: Contact Radio ePlus
contact.description: Need help listening, want to suggest a station, or have a question about content? Contact us here.

bug.title: A station or page is not working
bug.body: Tell us which station or page has a problem, what happened, and whether you are using a phone or computer. A screenshot can help.

station.title: Station update
station.body: To add a station or correct its details, send us its name, country, official website, and listening link if you have one.

copyright.title: Copyright or removal
copyright.body: If you own content shown here and want it corrected or removed, send us the station or page link and details that help us review your request.

support.title: Need help?
support.body: Send us the station name or page link, along with a short description of the problem or question.

statistics.title: Radio statistics
statistics.description: See how many countries and radio stations you can explore on Radio ePlus.
statistics.coverage_description: Each region shows how many countries and stations are listed there.
statistics.method_body: These totals come from our most recently updated station list. They show listed stations, not how many are playing right now or how many people are listening.

error.generic_body: The page could not be loaded. Please return to the homepage and try again.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.description: Find out how Radio ePlus remembers your settings and measures visits to the website.

essential.title: Essential storage
essential.body: Your browser saves settings such as language, theme, favorites, and listening history on this device. This makes Radio ePlus easier to use when you return.

analytics.title: Website visit statistics
analytics.body: The main Radio ePlus website uses Google Analytics 4 to count visits and page views as soon as a page opens. Closing the cookie notice does not stop this measurement.

third_party.title: Third-party services
third_party.body: When you search for or listen to a station, other services may deliver audio, pictures, or program information. They may receive your IP address and use their own cookies.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can clear saved website data in your browser settings. This may also remove your favorite stations, listening history, and display preferences on this device.

changes.title: Updates
changes.body: We may update this policy when the website or its services change. You can always read the latest version here.

home.description: Browse stations by region and country, discover local radio, and start listening instantly.
